description: Externalized Playwright locators for webnhathuoc.com, keyed by logical, human-readable element name. No selector is ever hardcoded in automation code -- every locator used by infrastructure.automation.playwright_adapter must be looked up from this file via infrastructure.automation.selector_registry.selector_registry_loader.
provenance: Entries with status 'confirmed' are transcribed verbatim (locator only, never the recorded fill values) from real Playwright codegen recordings supplied as ground truth: 01_login.py, 02_open_import_invoice.py, 03_create_supplier.py, 04_create_medicine.py (2026-07-31), 05_full_flow_existing_supplier_medicine.py + 05a_full_flow_new_supplier_medicine_search_draft.py (2026-08), and 06_multi_line_items.py (2026-08, 5 line items in one invoice -- the first recording to show the real multi-line fill sequence and revealed that the per-line quantity/price/VAT fields are a single SHARED set, not per-row-suffixed as earlier evidence had suggested; see invoice_line.quantity_field's notes). A separate, non-script source also feeds this file: table_structure.html (2026-08), a real live-DOM snapshot (not a recording) of the invoice line-items table with 5 stable rows, which resolved the row-scoping question 06_multi_line_items.py's tbody:nth-child(N) evidence could not (see invoice_line.select_row_for_batch_button and the row-id-suffix formula referenced by invoice_line.quantity_field/unit_price_field/vat_field/discount_field). All script sources live in docs/reference/automation_scripts/ and are gitignored -- several contain real credentials, never committed; table_structure.html was described directly by the PO rather than supplied as a file in this repo. Entries with status 'derived' extend a confirmed structural pattern using a business rule confirmed separately by the Product Owner, or a reasonable inference from surrounding confirmed evidence (documented per-entry). Entries with status 'needs_verification' are not evidenced by any recording or PO confirmation and MUST be captured from a fresh Playwright codegen session (or manually verified against the live site) before PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider relies on them -- do not treat their 'value' as production-ready.

login.open_login_dialog_button.name: Đăng nhập
login.open_login_dialog_button.notes: CONFLICT WITH EARLIER EVIDENCE, not silently resolved: 01_login.py recorded this as .first (nth=0), but both newer recordings (05 and 05a, 2026-08) independently use .nth(1). Updated to nth=1 on a 2-of-3 majority from the more recent recordings, but this positional index is evidently not perfectly stable across sessions -- flag as a priority target for a live selector smoke test before trusting it in production. If it breaks, try nth=0 as a fallback.

login.username_field.name: Nhập tài khoản đăng nhập của
login.username_field.notes: Accessible name is truncated in the recording (the site's own placeholder text is longer); Playwright's default substring name matching still resolves it. Do not pass exact=true with this truncated string.

login.password_field.name: Nhập mật khẩu đăng nhập của b

login.submit_button.name: Đăng Nhập
login.submit_button.notes: Distinct element from login.open_login_dialog_button -- capitalization of 'Nhập' differs between the two recorded button names ('Đăng nhập' opens the dialog, 'Đăng Nhập' submits it) and is preserved verbatim; do not normalize casing.

login.close_notification_popup.notes: The 'Đóng' popup shown after login (a CSDL DQG notice, per PO). Base locator is every <a> tag on the page, filtered to the one containing 'Đóng' text -- broad by construction (mirrors the recording exactly), so the Provider must treat this as OPTIONAL/best-effort: attempt the close, and proceed normally if no matching element is found within a short timeout, since PO confirmed this popup does not always appear. Distinct element from supplier.creation_confirmation_close_button (a <button>, not an <a>) despite both showing 'Đóng' text. BUG FIX (2026-08, PO-confirmed via two consecutive real --dry-run runs): the first run's own newly-added log line ('not present, skipped') proved this is a genuine TIMING issue, not a wrong selector -- the popup was still visible on screen moments later. login() now uses PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider._click_if_eventually_visible (expect().to_be_visible() with its own longer, dedicated 8-second timeout, same real-DOM-polling mechanism as _wait_for_row_settled) instead of the short, generic _click_if_present used by every other optional-click site. This is a timeout increase grounded in real evidence, not a guess at a new selector -- the value/filter_has_text above are unchanged.

login.session_indicator.notes: Still no recording exercises is_session_valid(). Needs a locator for an element only present when authenticated (e.g. an account menu / logout control) so the Provider can check session validity without a full navigation round-trip.

open_import_invoice.add_new_button.notes: ROOT CAUSE, CONFIRMED AND FIXED (2026-08, PO-confirmed via a real screenshot of the live "Nhập Xuất" -> "Nhập hàng" flow, no longer a hypothesis): clicking "Nhập hàng" already lands directly on a fresh, ready-to-use "PHIẾU NHẬP HÀNG" form -- this third click was never needed on this account/site state. PO enumerated the REAL three "Thêm mới"-titled buttons that exist on that already-open form: (1) add supplier, (2) add another line item, (3) add a new medicine ("Thêm mới thuốc" -- exactly open_import_invoice.stray_add_product_dialog's #add-product-dialog). This entry's own get_by_title("Thêm mới").nth(2) was landing on (3), not opening a new invoice at all. REMOVED from open_import_invoice_form() entirely -- no replacement click needed. Kept in the registry (status not_applicable, not deleted) as a historical record of a genuine root-cause investigation, per this project's own provenance-preservation practice. The two secondary source citations (04_create_medicine.py:10, 05_full_flow...py:52) were re-examined during that investigation and found to likely never have been genuine "opens a new invoice" evidence either (see prior notes revision in git history) -- only 02_open_import_invoice.py:12's own minimal script ever supported this entry, and even that recording's own reason for including this click (an account/site state where "Nhập hàng" led to a list needing an explicit "create new" action, unlike the direct-to-form landing now confirmed) is understood only as a plausible explanation, not independently re-verified -- moot either way, since the click is removed regardless of why it was originally recorded.

open_import_invoice.stray_add_product_di.source: PO's own real --dry-run error report (2026-08, reproduced twice, stable): a click:supplier.add_new_trigger failure (pointer events intercepted) surfaced this exact dialog -- id="add-product-dialog" ("Thêm mới thuốc"), Bootstrap's own "in" class marking it visible -- already open immediately after open_import_invoice_form() completed, before any other interaction. Presence-only selector (detection, never a guessed close action).
open_import_invoice.stray_add_product_di.notes: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED AND FIXED (2026-08, PO-confirmed via real screenshot, no longer a hypothesis): open_import_invoice.add_new_button's own extra, unnecessary third click was landing directly on this dialog's own trigger ("Thêm mới thuốc", one of 3 real "Thêm mới" buttons on the already-open invoice form) instead of opening a new invoice -- removed from open_import_invoice_form() entirely; see that entry's own notes for the full analysis. This was NOT a stray/incomplete-draft-invoice-on-the-server issue as first suspected. This defensive check itself (open_import_invoice_form() still checks this right after its now-2-click sequence) is KEPT regardless, as a genuine second line of defense -- fails cleanly with a clear diagnostic instead of the opaque pointer-event-blocked Playwright timeout this previously surfaced as, should this dialog ever appear for a genuinely different reason in the future. Deliberately does NOT attempt to click any close/cancel control inside this dialog -- no real DOM evidence names which specific element that is, and guessing risks submitting a real, unintended medicine-creation dialog on the live site.

Scoping history, most recent first (2026-08, PO-confirmed): (3, current) #receiptNoteViewId -- broader than #supplierSearchBoxId (the trigger is a SIBLING of that container, not a descendant -- see supplier.search_input's own history) but still narrow enough to exclude #tblMain, per a real strict-mode-violation error's own suggested candidates. Verified via real live-page Console checks, not a recording: document.querySelectorAll('#itemSearchUISelectID').length === 42 first proved the id used for the 'Mat hang' (medicine) search box is NOT unique and must never be used as a selector for anything; document.querySelectorAll('#supplierSearchBoxId').length === 1 then confirmed this container id IS unique on the real invoice form.
supplier.search_input.notes: REVISED, root-caused fix for the real --dry-run failure this PO chased down across several rounds (PO-confirmed 2026-08, final): the prior approach scoped via role=row name='Nha cung cap:  LS Tong no: S' -- that name embeds the supplier's own OUTSTANDING DEBT FIGURE ('LS Tong no: ...'), a value that differs per supplier/session, so it only ever worked by coincidence during the one recording that produced it and legitimately times out against any other real debt value. #supplierSearchBoxId is PO-verified unique and wraps the whole supplier search block (search input, suggestion list, and the 'Them moi neu chua co'/add-new trigger -- see supplier.add_new_trigger, now scoped into this same container) -- this css selector needs no accessible-name matching and so has no dependency on any dynamic text at all. medicine.add_new_trigger.notes: #tblMain is the invoice line-item table; this trigger fires when a typed medicine name has no existing match on the current line. UNCHANGED, verified still structurally correct (2026-08) when supplier.add_new_trigger's own scope was corrected -- confirmed as candidate (2) in that real strict-mode-violation error, locator("#tblMain").get_by_title("Thêm mới nếu chưa có"), so this entry's own locator resolution is not affected either way. FLAGGED, not fixed (needs its own PO confirmation, not resolved here): that same real error log showed this exact element's ng-click is "addDrugGroup()", not an add-medicine-sounding handler -- open whether this trigger actually opens a MEDICINE creation dialog (this entry's own name/notes) or a DRUG GROUP creation dialog (medicine.group_dialog_root's own separate flow), or whether "addDrugGroup" is simply this site's real internal name for what is, in the UI, medicine creation. Do not assume either reading; verify against the real dialog that opens before relying on this distinction. CONFIRMED 2026-08 (PO direct DOM inspection, made while chasing an unrelated medicine.selected_match_chip bug): #tblMain IS the create-medicine ('Thêm mới thuốc') dialog's own inner table (has 'Nhóm thuốc'/'Mã thuốc' fields) -- the 'invoice line-item table' claim in this entry's own 'notes' above is WRONG. Do not reuse #tblMain as a line-item-table scope anywhere in this codebase without a fresh, independently-verified real anchor -- see PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider._LINE_ITEMS_TABLE_SCOPE's own comment for the affected usages.

medicine.search_result_option.source: 05a_...py:37; reinforced by 06_multi_line_items.py:53,75 (role=cell, full descriptive string). BUG FIX #2 (2026-08, PO-confirmed via a real DOM snapshot): outerHTML of one real result row copied directly from a live --dry-run session's search-result dropdown -- '893100160624 - Coldi-B DNHGiá nhập.../Tồn.../SĐK...'.
medicine.search_result_option.notes: HISTORY: originally role=cell, name=<medicine name substring>, exact=false, matching the FULL descriptive cell text ('{SĐK} - {tên thuốc} Giá nhập: .../... - Tồn: ... - SĐK: ... - Hãng sản xuất: ... - QCĐG: ...'). BUG FIX #2 (2026-08, PO-confirmed via two consecutive real --dry-run runs -- CRITICAL, wrong-medicine-selection risk): the IDENTICAL 'Row 2 did not settle' failure at the IDENTICAL point (Naphacogyl -> Coldi) on both runs, despite both _wait_for_row_settled and _MEDICINE_SELECTION_SETTLE_MS already being in place, ruled out timing and pointed at a selection-matching bug. PO confirmed live: typing 'Coldi' returns >= 4 real results (this account's search reaches the national drug database, not just an internal catalog), each with its own real SĐK code prefix the automation cannot predict in advance (e.g. '893100160624 - Coldi-B DNH', '893110391924 - Coldi') -- the old exact=false substring match on the full cell text matched BOTH 'Coldi' and 'Coldi-B DNH' when searching 'Coldi' (substring collision), and a full exact match is not possible either (the numeric code prefix is real, dynamic, and unknown ahead of time). PO's own real DOM snapshot (see 'source' above) revealed the fix: the FIRST <b> tag inside each result cell contains ONLY '{code} - {tên thuốc}' (clean, no price/stock -- those live in a separate, ever-changing sibling <span class="info-item">). strategy='text_ends_with' (see PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider._locate_parameterized's own implementation) builds an END-anchored, case-insensitive regex from the runtime medicine name and filters this <b> tag by it -- 'Coldi$' matches '...- Coldi' but NOT '...- Coldi-B DNH' (which ends in 'DNH'), and vice versa 'Coldi-B DNH$' only matches the longer one. 'value': 'b' is the real, confirmed CSS tag for this element (not a guess -- copied directly from the real snapshot's own tag name). WATCH FOR: if a different medicine's real result cell nests the name differently (e.g. no <b> wrapper, or multiple <b> tags per cell), this will need re-verification -- the current fix is grounded in exactly one real snapshot (the Coldi/Coldi-B DNH case), not exhaustively checked against every medicine name shape. BUG FIX #3 (2026-08, PO-confirmed via a real --dry-run run, investigated and root-caused via code reading, not a live DOM snapshot this time): PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider.search_medicine() was checking this selector's .count() IMMEDIATELY after fill(), with no settle wait at all -- a false negative here (site's search-as-you-type not yet finished) makes an ALREADY-existing medicine look 'not found', triggering an unnecessary create_medicine() call. search_medicine() now waits _MEDICINE_SELECTION_SETTLE_MS first, same reasoning/constant already used by _search_and_select_medicine_for_line.

medicine.search_result_option_by_code.source: Same real <b> tag element as medicine.search_result_option (see that entry's own 'source' snapshot) -- no separate recording of its own.
medicine.search_result_option_by_code.notes: DERIVED (2026-08, Part 1 of the multi-result-disambiguation feature, PO-approved 2026-08): reuses the SAME already-confirmed {code} - {tên thuốc} shape medicine.search_result_option's own real DOM snapshot established, just anchored from the OTHER end -- START-anchored on the code, instead of END-anchored on the name. Used only when a Medicine already has a confirmed website_catalog_code (Medicine.website_catalog_code, migrations.migration_0004_add_website_catalog_code) from a prior real selection -- lets automation jump straight to the exact right row by its unique code instead of re-disambiguating an ambiguous name (e.g. 'Naphacogyl', PO-confirmed to appear on >= 4 distinct real catalog rows) every single time. This specific anchor direction has not been independently re-confirmed against a fresh live DOM snapshot of its own -- flagged 'derived', not 'confirmed', for exactly that reason; re-verify if a different medicine's real result cell ever turns out to nest code+name differently (same caveat medicine.search_result_option's own notes already flag).

Hãng sản xuất: Công ty cổ phần dược phẩm Nam Hà - QCĐG: Lọ'.
medicine.search_result_info_item.notes:
Part 2 of the multi-result-disambiguation feature (2026-08, PO-approved): the ever-changing sibling span medicine.search_result_option's own notes already named but never captured evidence for. Each field is its OWN 'Nhãn: Giá trị' pair, fields separated by ' - ' -- field COUNT and ORDER are NOT fixed (snapshot 1 has 3 fields: Giá nhập/Hãng sản xuất/QCĐG; snapshot 2 has 5: Giá nhập/Tồn/SĐK/Hoạt chất/Hãng sản xuất/QCĐG, plus a
before Hãng sản xuất) -- PlaywrightBrowserAutomationProvider._extract_manufacturer therefore locates by the 'Hãng sản xuất:' label text itself, never by position. Used relationally, not as a standalone page-wide locator: for one specific ambiguous medicine.search_result_option row, the adapter takes that row's own parent cell and looks up '.info-item' within it (same 'combine a registered fragment with runtime-computed context' pattern already used by _fill_row_specific_field's row-suffix formula) -- this is why 'scope' is left unset here rather than pointing at a fixed page-wide root.
